rows.label: qst650306_msg0001
rows.name: Is everyone unharmed?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0002
rows.name:
As you can see, everyone's safe, and
we took care of the Garlus.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0003
rows.name: Well! That is excellent news!

rows.label: qst650306_msg0004
rows.name:
I'll dispatch a squad to Genbu's Head
right away.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0005
rows.name:
Yeah. Can't have something else taking
it over.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0006
rows.name:
Prince Zeke, everyone, thank you so
much. Thanks to you, we avoided any
casualties.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0007
rows.name: As for your reward...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0008
rows.name:
Don't worry about it. We
didn't do it for the reward.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0009
rows.name:
King Seelig entrusted me with a
special reward...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0010
rows.name: Then let's take it.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0011
rows.name: Talk about a quick change of heart...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0012
rows.name:
I thought it'd be wrong if the
Luxurian soldiers had chipped in from
their pay to reward us.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0013
rows.name:
But King Seelig is rich, and he's
Zeke's dad, so I figured it's fine.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0014
rows.name:
Indeed. We didn't contribute a single
coin, so please accept it without
hesitation.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0015
rows.name: Yeah, thanks.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0016
rows.name:
If you ever need help again, let us
know. We'll come running right away.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0017
rows.name:
He said something cool again and
walked off...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0018
rows.name: He's never going to change, mo...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0019
rows.name: Yeah...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0101
rows.name:
Whew. Glad we got that
over with safely.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0102
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0103
rows.name:
Kamuya really helped us, especially
with that last Garlus...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0104
rows.name: I only did what any Blade would.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0105
rows.name: Even so...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0106
rows.name:
It made me think I need to become
strong enough and trusted enough for
Kamuya to let me use that white sword.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0107
rows.name: Haha.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0108
rows.name:
That's the spirit. That's my best
friend.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0109
rows.name:
I'm counting on you from now on too,
Kamuya.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0110
rows.name: Yeah. Leave it to me.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0113
rows.name:
Seriously, I can't lend you Futsu's
Sword, okay?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0114
rows.name: Aww, can't I try it just once?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0115
rows.name: No. Absolutely not.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0116
rows.name:
I want to try dual-wielding like
Kamuya.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0117
rows.name:
Absolutely not. Even to my best
friend, I can't lend my sword.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0201
rows.name:
Whew. Glad we got that
over with safely.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0202
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0203
rows.name:
Kamuya really helped us, especially
with that last Garlus...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0204
rows.name: I only did what any Blade would.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0205
rows.name:
Even so, I thought I need to become
strong enough and trusted enough for
Kamuya to let me use that white sword.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0206
rows.name: Haha.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0207
rows.name:
That's the spirit. That's my best
friend.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0208
rows.name: Showing off again.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0209
rows.name: Huh? Am I?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0210
rows.name: I'll be careful this time.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0211
rows.name:
Yeah. I don't expect much, but I'll
hold you to it.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0212
rows.name: That's harsh...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0213
rows.name:
Still, I'm counting on you from now
on, Nia.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0214
rows.name: Same here.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0301
rows.name:
Whew. Glad we got that
over with safely.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0302
rows.name: Indeed.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0303
rows.name:
Kamuya helped us. That move that
defeated the last Garlus was splendid.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0304
rows.name: I only did what any Blade would.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0305
rows.name: Even so...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0306
rows.name:
I thought I should become strong
enough and trusted enough for Kamuya
to let me use Futsu's Sword.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0307
rows.name: Haha.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0308
rows.name:
That's the spirit. That's my best
friend.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0309
rows.name:
Heh... You really are a troublesome
one, Kamuya.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0310
rows.name: What's the problem?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0311
rows.name:
I've gained many comrades-in-arms, but
I'm still not used to having a best
friend.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0312
rows.name:
That's all? Don't worry. You'll get
used to it.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0313
rows.name: That's exactly the problem...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0401
rows.name:
Whew. Glad we got that
over with safely.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0402
rows.name: Tell me about it.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0403
rows.name:
Kamuya really helped us, especially
that move that took down the last
Garlus...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0404
rows.name: I only did what any Blade would.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0405
rows.name: That's it...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0406
rows.name: Hmm?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0407
rows.name:
That Futsu's Sword of yours is really
unfair, isn't it?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0408
rows.name: Unfair?

rows.label: qst650306_msg0409
rows.name:
It's like a secret weapon. You hardly
ever draw it, it's crazy strong, and
it looks cool...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0410
rows.name:
And you haven't let me use it even
once.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0411
rows.name:
Even if you say that... It's really
dangerous unless you're a Blade.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0412
rows.name: Well, you never know until you try.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0413
rows.name:
No, no. I can't lend it to you, even
if you became the strongest Driver in
Alst.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0414
rows.name:
Next time I'll take it while you're
asleep.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0415
rows.name: Wha?!

rows.label: qst650306_msg0416
rows.name:
Maybe I should sleep in a different
room from Zeke.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0417
rows.name: Hahaha! I'm kidding.

rows.label: qst650306_msg0418
rows.name: It sounded serious to me...

rows.label: qst650306_msg0419
rows.name:
Still, I'm counting on you from now
on, best friend.
